# ADR 0003: Protected attributes are unreachable from the decision path

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** Mortgage application decision API

## Context

Fair lending rules prohibit using race, sex or age in decisions, but fairness must still be measured.

## Decision

Decision packages can't import the HMDA/analytics packages (checked by a test); disparity is measured only in backtests.

## Consequences

Fairness by construction plus measurement. Analysts need separate access.

## Alternatives considered

Filtering fields at runtime.
